FIELD GUIDE

How to renovate

Declutter & switch on

Aim at glowing tasks and hold INTERACT. The Hand tool clears dust and lights the lamps.

Patch the stone

Choose REPAIR, then hold interact on a cracked slab until the ring closes.

Choose a palette

Select PAINT, pick a colour, then hold interact on each faded accent wall.

Restyle the room

Select ARRANGE, grab a marked piece, steer it to its gold ring, tap ROTATE to align and place it.
